description: Multi-step LangGraph StateGraph as a Dagster asset. Either a declarative prompt-chain DSL (`steps`) or a bring-your-own pre-built graph (`graph_fn`) -- exactly one of the two must be set.

outputs.description: steps mode: {input, outputs, final, steps_run, stopped_by, model, provider}. graph_fn mode: whatever dict your own graph returns.

input_prompt.label: Initial Input Prompt
input_prompt.description: Required in `steps` mode (seed prompt; available as {input} in every step). Optional in `graph_fn` mode (merged into initial state under `input`). Supports {run_id}, {partition_key}, {partition_keys.<dim>}.

graph_fn.label: Graph Function
graph_fn.description: 'module.path:function_name' dotted path to a callable, defined in your own project, returning an already-built LangGraph graph exposing `.invoke(state)`. Called as `graph_fn(context) -> graph`. Mutually exclusive with `steps` -- set exactly one. Resolved at materialize time, not component-load time.

initial_state.label: Initial State
initial_state.description: Only used with `graph_fn`. Extra keys merged into the state dict passed to graph.invoke(...). String values support {run_id}/{partition_key}/{partition_keys.<dim>} substitution. Wins over input_prompt's `input` key on conflict.

steps.label: Graph Steps
steps.description: Ordered LLM steps (declarative prompt-chain mode). Mutually exclusive with `graph_fn` -- set exactly one. A step continues only if it explicitly sets `next` or `condition_regex`; omitting both terminates that branch at END.

name.description: Unique node name. Referenced by `next` and templated as {outputs.<name>}.

system_message.description: Optional system message for this step (overrides component-level system_message).

model.description: Optional per-step model override (defaults to component-level model).

next.description: Next step name. Omitting this (or 'END') terminates this branch at END -- no implicit fall-through to the next declared step.

condition_regex.description: If set, route to `next` on match else to `condition_else`.

condition_else.description: Where to route when condition_regex does NOT match. Defaults to END.

llm_provider.label: Provider
llm_provider.description: One of: openai / anthropic / azure_openai / google / ollama..

api_key_env_var.description: Env var containing the provider API key.
api_key_env_var.label: API Key Env Var

api_base_env_var.description: Env var containing a custom base URL (for Azure / Ollama / self-hosted).
api_base_env_var.label: API Base URL Env Var

system_message.description: Default system message applied to every step. Overridable per step.
system_message.label: Default System Message
